control_design: Two independently allocated fixed-address input, output, and if applicable coefficient/scratch buffer sets; same input contents; distinct captured graph objects. Cross comparison uses the same buffer separation. Session 1 captures X then Y and session 2 captures Y then X.
cross_extra_control: Eight same-instance staged A/A blocks, one before each cross A/B round, reproduce the MI-Research-6D rule input without modifying that rule.
predeclared_offline_diagnostics: Unchanged schema-v3 cross decision with its same-instance staged A/A control
Per-session count of positive paired staged-minus-fused differences
Median and range of paired differences from each independent null and cross condition
Maximum, median, and empirical 90th percentile of absolute independent-null differences
Descriptive comparison of cross paired gaps to same-instance and independent staged-null distributions
First-half versus second-half median event times and block-position/order traces
Host-submission, synchronized perf_counter, RAW, and CUDA-event intervals for every block
interpretation_rule: These are sensitivity diagnostics, not replacement production decisions. Do not choose a threshold after seeing the cross result or retroactively relabel MI-Research-6D. Any replacement requires prospective null and known-contrast validation.
